title: Like a $1 store blanket but super soft and pretty; thin as a sheet
text:
Like a $1 store blanket but super soft and pretty; thin as a sheet. This blanket is as thin as a sheet. Had I paid the current price of $23.90, I would have been extremely upset. I do not feel this is worth more than $8.

This is best to hang up on the wall. There is no warmth or heft in this blanket. It is very soft and super attractive as can be seen from the third photo, but not worth the money. It is best used as a privacy curtain or wall hanging or as a thin wrap or to lay out on the beach as a large super thin "towel." However, a towel is thicker and this is not what I expected to receive when I ordered a blanket.

There is no label on this which is good and bad. I assume it has to be washed in cold water but I would expect it to disintegrate in the laundry. This is disposable to me.
